lines.text: Lesson twenty-six: understanding AI decisions. Phase 6, XORA Intelligence.
lines.say: Lesson twenty-six: understanding AI decisions. Phase six, Zora Intelligence.

lines.text: In T25 you saw how XORA analyses a coin. Now: what does it decide, and why?
lines.say: In T twenty-five you saw how Zora analyses a coin. Now: what does it decide, and why?

lines.text: For each coin, XORA's engine gives one of three answers. It's not a prediction.
lines.say: For each coin, Zora's engine gives one of three answers. It's not a prediction.

lines.text: It is the result of rule-based checks.
lines.say: It is the result of rule-based checks.

lines.text: Answer one: BUY, also called long. You gain if the price rises after you enter.
lines.say: Answer one: buy, also called long. You gain if the price rises after you enter.

lines.text: Answer two: SELL, also called SHORT. You gain if the price falls after you enter.
lines.say: Answer two: sell, also called SHORT. You gain if the price falls after you enter.

lines.text: Answer three: NO TRADE. You stand aside and wait. No setup right now.
lines.say: Answer three: NO TRADE. You stand aside and wait. No setup right now.

lines.text: A plan is for one candle only: BUY if price trades above 60,120, for example.
lines.say: A plan is for one candle only: buy if price trades above sixty thousand one hundred twenty, for example.

lines.text: How does XORA choose? With checks: yes-or-no tests written as rules in code.
lines.say: How does Zora choose? With checks: yes-or-no tests written as rules in code.

lines.text: Like a pilot's checklist before take-off. Each item is ticked, or it isn't.
lines.say: Like a pilot's checklist before take-off. Each item is ticked, or it isn't.

lines.text: The filters use common techniques: trend, support and resistance, volume, momentum and more.
lines.say: The filters use common techniques: trend, support and resistance, volume, momentum and more.

lines.text: Confidence is a score for how much evidence agrees with a setup.
lines.say: Confidence is a score for how much evidence agrees with a setup.

lines.text: Think of witnesses. One witness is weak. Several who agree, independently, are stronger.
lines.say: Think of witnesses. One witness is weak. Several who agree, independently, are stronger.

lines.text: Each confirmation that agrees raises the score. A check that disagrees, or has no data, adds nothing.
lines.say: Each confirmation that agrees raises the score. A check that disagrees, or has no data, adds nothing.

lines.text: In the app, this is the ENTRY CHECKLIST. Each check shows a tick or a cross.
lines.say: In the app, this is the ENTRY CHECKLIST. Each check shows a tick or a cross.

lines.text: BUY shows 72% / 60%: a score of 72, against your minimum of 60. It meets it, so it's READY.
lines.say: Buy shows seventy-two percent out of sixty percent: a score of seventy-two, against your minimum of sixty. It meets it, so it's READY.

lines.text: SELL shows 55% / 60%. Below your minimum, so no READY badge, and no sell.
lines.say: Sell shows fifty-five percent out of sixty percent. Below your minimum, so no READY badge, and no sell.

lines.text: Fictional numbers, of course.
lines.say: Fictional numbers, of course.

lines.text: A common mistake: reading 72% as a 72% chance of winning.
lines.say: A common mistake: reading seventy-two percent as a seventy-two percent chance of winning.

lines.text: That's wrong. The app itself says: confidence is evidence strength, not a chance of winning.
lines.say: That's wrong. The app itself says: confidence is evidence strength, not a chance of winning.

lines.text: A READY trade can still lose. Every trade needs a stop and a size you can afford.
lines.say: A READY trade can still lose. Every trade needs a stop and a size you can afford.

lines.text: Even a READY setup must pass safety checks. Any one of them can block the trade.
lines.say: Even a READY setup must pass safety checks. Any one of them can block the trade.

lines.text: Is the spread too wide? Is the market too thin? Is the data stale, or the plan expired?
lines.say: Is the spread too wide? Is the market too thin? Is the data stale, or the plan expired?

lines.text: Is the stop too tight or too wide? Is there too little room to the next level?
lines.say: Is the stop too tight or too wide? Is there too little room to the next level?

lines.text: If any check fails: no trade.
lines.say: If any check fails: no trade.

lines.text: Markets are often unclear. Price chops sideways, and the checks disagree.
lines.say: Markets are often unclear. Price chops sideways, and the checks disagree.

lines.text: Then XORA shows No trade, with its reasons, and keeps watching. That's a good outcome.
lines.say: Then Zora shows No trade, with its reasons, and keeps watching. That's a good outcome.

lines.text: No trade means no loss. Waiting is a decision, and often the wise one.
lines.say: No trade means no loss. Waiting is a decision, and often the wise one.

lines.text: In Trade Settings you choose a confidence threshold: Enter only at or above. Default: 50%.
lines.say: In Trade Settings you choose a confidence threshold: Enter only at or above. Default: fifty percent.

lines.text: From 50% up, XORA uses several indicators for confirmation. Higher means more must agree.
lines.say: From fifty percent up, Zora uses several indicators for confirmation. Higher means more must agree.

lines.text: 45% is special. It's not 45% confidence: XORA then looks for chart-pattern setups instead.
lines.say: Forty-five percent is special. It's not forty-five percent confidence: Zora then looks for chart-pattern setups instead.

lines.text: Entry modes change the filters: Basic looks for chances, Secure wants more confirmation, Advanced adds more.
lines.say: Entry modes change the filters: Basic looks for chances, Secure wants more confirmation, Advanced adds more.

lines.text: Auto trade approval is off by default. A triggered setup waits for you to tap Approve.
lines.say: Auto trade approval is off by default. A triggered setup waits for you to tap Approve.

lines.text: Approve before its one-minute candle ends, or it expires.
lines.say: Approve before its one-minute candle ends, or it expires.

lines.text: With auto approval on, the engine enters by itself, within your settings.
lines.say: With auto approval on, the engine enters by itself, within your settings.

lines.text: Your own BUY or SHORT tap is always your call. The sheet says if the engine agrees.
lines.say: Your own buy or SHORT tap is always your call. The sheet says if the engine agrees.

lines.text: Your turn. Read the checklist and choose an answer. Pause if you need more time.
lines.say: Your turn. Read the checklist and choose an answer. Pause if you need more time.

lines.text: Answer B. 68 is below your minimum of 70, so no READY, and no trade.
lines.say: Answer B. Sixty-eight is below your minimum of seventy, so no READY, and no trade.

lines.text: And C is wrong: confidence is not a chance of winning.
lines.say: And C is wrong: confidence is not a chance of winning.

lines.text: Before you trust any decision, know its limits.
lines.say: Before you trust any decision, know its limits.

lines.text: XORA does not guarantee profits. Rules can be wrong, and losing trades happen.
lines.say: Zora does not guarantee profits. Rules can be wrong, and losing trades happen.

lines.text: Prices can jump past a stop, fees add up, and leverage makes losses bigger.
lines.say: Prices can jump past a stop, fees add up, and leverage makes losses bigger.

lines.text: So practise in DEMO first. This is education, not financial advice.
lines.say: So practise in demo first. This is education, not financial advice.

lines.text: Recap. XORA gives three answers: BUY, SELL or SHORT, or NO TRADE, from rule-based checks.
lines.say: Recap. Zora gives three answers: buy, sell or SHORT, or NO TRADE, from rule-based checks.

lines.text: Confidence is evidence strength, checked against your minimum. Safety checks can still say no.
lines.say: Confidence is evidence strength, checked against your minimum. Safety checks can still say no.

lines.text: Check yourself: 80% / 60%, but the spread is too wide. Trade? No, the safety check blocks it.
lines.say: Check yourself: eighty percent out of sixty percent, but the spread is too wide. Trade? No, the safety check blocks it.

lines.text: Next: T27, reading XORA trading insights. XORA does not guarantee profits. Demo first. Not financial advice.
lines.say: Next: T twenty-seven, reading Zora trading insights. Zora does not guarantee profits. Demo first. Not financial advice.
